sourceGeneration.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a production pixel-art source sheet for Human Last Rampart top-down tactical map. Transparent background, no text. TWO distinct isolated subjects horizontally side by side with huge transparent margins, no frame borders: LEFT a small buried medieval black-powder explosive trap viewed strictly top-down: round compact brown soil disturbed patch, a partially buried brass/dark iron cap, tiny red fuse nub; no modern landmine, no perspective side wall. RIGHT a small ochre/brown dig dust puff, a compact irregular cloud with 3 connected rounded lobes, designed for a burial effect. Strong chunky readable pixel clusters, dark 1-pixel-looking outline, three tones per material, muted olive brown dirt, aged brass and warm pale ochre dust. Low resolution game sprite aesthetic, designed to reduce trap to 20x20 pixels and cloud to 24x16 pixels, absolutely no tiny photorealistic texture, no blur, no glow, no lettering. Two subjects only, centers at quarter and three-quarter of canvas, same apparent size. Preserve actual transparent alpha. Palette/style compatible with muted olive/brass medieval top-down map and Octopath-inspired chunky sprites.
sourceGeneration.postprocess: 두 피사체 영역별 불투명 경계 추출, 20×20 및 28×18 최근접 샘플, 제한 팔레트, 가장 큰 연결 덩어리 보존, 아이콘 외곽선, 상태 겉칠, 먼지 크기·상승·투명도 변환
